failures.description: smoke/test-mass-agent-run-0: campaign job never provisioned. The controller waited on the shared warm-source donor 683e47df5094d8, which another owner's fleet had started (12 navi-whisper-lux-bench Machines created 07:03-07:13Z, no controller on this host); 6 jobs exited with '❌ warm source must be stopped before fleet provisioning (state=started)' and 3 were TERMed during the wait (07:20:13, exit 143).
failures.evidence: .context/deploy-cloud/f4850a7b42809d5ca44d2dc70585b4e3a2777efe3a31394e20c08bca8e091b36/cli.log and campaign job logs r001-j000*.log (each shows 'waiting for machine 683e47df5094d8 to stop' x8). Campaign summary status failed, no shared-cleanup flags, nothing provisioned. Shared-resource contention on the Fly bench app; PR #1724 changes no cloudbench/controller code (scripts/benchmark-history-*.py, CLAUDE.md, deploy.md, ledgers). Donor observed 'stopped' and the app back to 14 Machines at 07:25Z.
failures.assigned_reason: Deploy owner keeps the repair: rerun the bound smoke gate unchanged once the shared donor is free (it was stopped at 07:25Z).
